name: Vestige Operator Lite
description: Deterministic pre-tool gate: classifies every shell command against a closed rule set (15 STOP rules: OP-000 to OP-011, OP-014, OP-018 and OP-CANARY; 15 SHADOW rules: OP-S01 to OP-S08 and OP-S11 to OP-S17), follows cd / shell variables / heredocs, sees through GuardFall-class obfuscation, writes hash-chained receipts. The gate is bundled. Enforce mode by default: it stops what a STOP rule matches. To record without blocking: echo shadow > ~/.operator/mode
